_about: The one design-token file for the app and the admin portal. Edit here, then run: python scripts/brand_sync.py. Tints are the colour mixed with white at the given percentage.
_palette_note: Palette of 2026-11-12 (replaces the IHS Teal base): forest, deep forest (bottom navigation), logo teal (primary), mid-blend (hero image fade), 15% teal background; supporting ink, muted ink, card, pale teal, warning and error. 2026-11-12: the gold accent replaced by the pale teal background tint (decision).
_tints_note: forestGreen10, warningOrange10 and errorRed10 are the pale callout backgrounds; teal88 is the light end of the button sheen (white text on it 5.15:1).
_semantic_note: Palette of 2026-11-12. Screens on tealMist, cards on card with the thin teal border; app bars and primary buttons teal with white text; bottom navigation deep forest; hero card forest to teal with pale teal accents. Warning orange is a border/icon colour on its pale tint (as text there it is 4.48:1), so warning text is ink. Every text pair passes 4.5:1 (docs/brand/contrast_report.md).

font.heading: Fraunces
font._note: The app's original bundled fonts (SIL OFL 1.1), kept by decision 2026-11-11 instead of the guide's Helvetica Neue. They lack the Hausa letters (ɓ ɗ ƙ ƴ); those come from the fallback (Roboto/Noto on Android). The admin uses its original system font stack.

blends._note: border is rgba(0,104,92,0.18) laid on the card colour, stored opaque so every platform draws the same.
